new_results.statement: For Z=sqrt(q)X0+sqrt(1-q)T with source-disjoint cap-one X0 and residual orthonormal projection (T,C,D), S=2 beta Z C+ell Z+R(C,D) satisfies sup_s E|S-s|^-1/2 <=2^(11/4)q^-1/4|beta|^-1/2.
The same S satisfies integral |t|^-1/2|phi_S(t)|^2 dt <=2^(13/4)sqrt(pi)q^-1/4|beta|^-1/2; for exact rank3 q>=1/2 and spectral gap s, this is <=8sqrt(2pi)s^-1/2.
A genuine independent square d(Y+h)^2 converts the near-coloop half-Riesz budget to ||p||inf<=8(|d|s)^-1/2 in q>=1/2 exact-rank3 scope.
A source-disjoint invertible indefinite outer pair with determinant D_B and kappa=sigma_min converts the near-coloop budget to ||p||inf<=16s^-1/4(D_B kappa)^-1/4 in q>=1/2 scope.
